mapper.insert: INSERT INTO itinerary (user_id, session_id, title, city, start_date, days, budget, advice, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{sessionId}, #{title}, #{city}, #{startDate}, #{days}, #{budget}, #{advice}, COALESCE(#{status}, 0))
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM itinerary WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY pinned DESC, create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM itinerary WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE itinerary SET session_id = NULL WHERE session_id = #{sessionId}
UPDATE itinerary SET pinned = #{pinned} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE itinerary SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE itinerary SET deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
